'''Shan Tanner''' was a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was the son of [[Jahn Tanner|Jahn]] and [[Lania Tanner]] and lived on the [[Tanner Ranch]] in the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]]. Tanner typically dressed in a tan tunic with blue leggings and a canvas hat.

Tanner encountered a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who crashed near the ranch in the middle of a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]]. Shortly after, Tanner, his family, and their farmhands were forced to relocate to [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] in the face of a marauding force of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].
